module_summary: Synchronous FIFO: memory array addressed by wrapping write/read pointers, fill counter derives full/empty, asynchronous read of mem at rd_addr.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO data array written at wr_addr, read at rd_addr.

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request; qualified by !o_full into w_wr.

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request/consumer accept; qualified by !o_empty into w_rd.

anchors.name: o_full
anchors.why: Full backpressure to writer, blocks writes.

anchors.name: o_empty
anchors.why: Empty indication to reader, blocks reads.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count; MSB gives full, used for empty update.

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Write pointer incremented on accepted write, addresses mem.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Read pointer incremented on accepted read, addresses mem.

anchors.name: r_empty
anchors.why: Registered empty flag updated from fill on read/write.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Accepted write enable: mem write, wr_addr and fill increment.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Accepted read enable: rd_addr increment, fill decrement.

groups.name: Write port
groups.description: Qualifies writes against full, advances write pointer.

groups.name: Read port
groups.description: Qualifies reads against empty, advances read pointer, outputs mem data.

groups.name: Occupancy tracking
groups.description: Fill counter producing full flag and empty updates.
